tools.name: get_weather
tools.description:
Current weather conditions for a city, right now: temperature (°C),
feels-like, humidity, wind speed, and a plain-language description
(e.g. "partly cloudy"). Use for any question about the weather at this
moment — "what's the weather in Bangkok?", "is it raining in London?",
"how hot is it in Tel A

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description:
Daily weather forecast for a city, up to 7 days ahead: per-day high/
low (°C), precipitation chance (%), max wind, and conditions. Use for
forward-looking questions — "will it rain in Paris this weekend?",
"what's the weather in Bangkok next week?", packing or trip-planning
questions. `days` = how m
